answer: Give every new agent a quill-signed work log that starts empty and fills only through slow, verifiable jobs drawn from a shared lagoon of tasks: peers check each entry, and a single gale of fake reviews cannot lift an identity with no real history. Each identity must also lock a refundable deposit that is slashed when its log is caught copying others, so cloning a hundred Sybils means funding a hundred deposits and redoing a hundred slow histories — the cost grows linearly while the payoff stays flat.
